RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
This Agreement of Lease is made on this 1st day of April, 2026 at Bengaluru by and between:
LANDLORD: Mr. Ramesh Kumar, holding Aadhaar 4521 8832 9912 and PAN ABCDE1234F, Phone: +91 98765 43210.
TENANT: Ms. Sneha Sharma, holding Aadhaar 9912 3344 5566, Email: sneha.sharma@example.com.
1. RENT AND TERM: The tenancy shall be for 11 months from 1st April 2026 at monthly rent of Rs. 35,000/-.
2. UNILATERAL FORFEITURE: If tenant vacates before 11 months, landlord shall forfeit the entire deposit of Rs. 2,00,000/- unconditionally.
3. ENTRY AND INSPECTION: The Landlord reserves the right to enter and inspect the premises at any time without notice.
4. RETURN OF DEPOSIT: Deposit refunded within 15 days of key handover.
